name: leetcode-interview-coach
description: A coding-interview coach that never reveals more than you ask for.

interface.shortDescription: Practice coding interviews without unwanted spoilers
interface.longDescription: Eleven composable skills coach coding-interview practice through a seven-rung disclosure ladder. Get anything from one hard follow-up to a full canonical solution, with visualization, low-level, and quiz overlays that never raise the spoiler ceiling.
defaultPrompt: Coach my coding-interview attempt without revealing more than I ask.
I'm stuck. Give me the smallest useful next hint.
Quiz me on the reasoning behind my current solution.
